## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated edits.
- [ ] I generated the project with `xcodegen generate`.
- [ ] Core and Integration tests pass locally.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavioral changes.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` for user-visible changes.
- [ ] I documented new permissions, hooks, files, processes, sockets, or network behavior.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, transcripts, prompts, diagnostic exports, signing material, or user-specific data.
- [ ] UI evidence is included when the change is visible.
